why: der Diesel described three different words at once. The 2026-08-14 gender audit caught the article; this is the rest of it. The gloss named the regional Cola-Bier drink (sense 4 on de.wiktionary), the synonyms belonged to that drink and to dirt (Schweinebier, Schmutz, Moorwasser — the page's Synonyme for sense 4, 'Dreckiges'), while the definition covered senses 1 and 3 and both examples are about fuel. The definition and the examples agree with each other, so they decide: this card is the fuel and the engine.

rows.src: de.wiktionary Diesel — Synonyme [1] Dieselmotor, [3] Dieselöl / Dieseltreibstoff, matching Bedeutungen [1] 'Kurzform für Dieselmotor' and [3] 'Kurzform für Dieselkraftstoff'.
